subject: scripts/adapter-unittest.py: built-in unittest adapter (select/run/full writing result.json schema 1); status.py done --result; verify.py --result/--case; A's tests.unittest.map/base data
objective: Design docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md (D-071) C6 (adapter half), C7 (fields), section 4 'Built-in unittest adapter' + 'result.json (schema 1)' table + the status-file row of 'How A's existing features sit on the interface', follow-up row 3a. (1) scripts/adapter-unittest.py (one runner in A; status.py cmd_run_tests moves into it). Env per section 4: AC_HOME AC_ROOT AC_CODE_ROOT AC_TEST_OUT AC_TEST_MODE AC_TICKET AC_RUN_ID AC_TEST_TIMEOUT (AC_TEST_OUT required for run/full: missing -> rc 2). Config from AC_ROOT/board/config.json tests.unittest: roots (default ['tests']), pattern (default test_*.py), base (default []), map (default []; list of {match, ids}; match uses fnmatch semantics = sh case '*' crossing '/'; first match wins; ids [] = 'no test, not unmapped'). 'select --mode branch': changed files repo-relative one per line on stdin; per file: map first match, else tests/<root>/test_*.py that exists under AC_CODE_ROOT -> its module id, else 'unmapped <file>'; stdout one item per line deduped, rc 0 when stdin had >= 1 line, rc 3 with a stderr reason when stdin was empty. 'select --mode base': prints tests.unittest.base, rc 0 (rc 3 when empty). 'run <id>...': in-process loader.loadTestsFromNames over roots (cwd and sys.path as today: <AC_CODE_ROOT>/<root>), zero ids -> rc 2 and no result.json; 'full': discover over roots with pattern. Both run with today's EnvironmentResult (statistical suspects, environment_fail_fast_threshold from AC_ROOT config) and LogStream into $AC_TEST_OUT/run.log (full.log for full), then write $AC_TEST_OUT/result.json: schema 1, command, ac_test_mode, started, seconds, ids[] rows {id (unittest id module.Class.method, rerunnable via run <id>), status pass/fail/error/skip, message (first line of the exception text; skip reason; a skip with empty reason becomes status error with message 'skip without reason'), exception (type name), file (repo-relative to AC_CODE_ROOT) + line of the innermost traceback frame inside a test file under roots, seconds, traceback (full text)}, environment_suspect (statistical rows from EnvironmentResult + declared rows from ENVIRONMENT-SUSPECT: lines in the log, seven D-019 keys, [] when none), log. Exit: 0 all pass/skip, 1 any fail/error, 86 when environment_suspect non-empty (rows in the file), 2 could not run. (2) status.py run-tests becomes a thin shim over the adapter keeping its flags, rc, --log and --suspect-file contract so gate.sh and tests/test_status.py stay green until row 3b deletes it. (3) status.py done gains --result <result.json> (repeatable, alongside --log which stays an attachment): failures[] rows from fail/error ids with keys case (= id) / file / line / excerpt (= message) plus the existing kind/subtest/engine/log keys; environment_suspect rows from the result merged like --environment-log (statistical first, then declared), normalised to the seven keys; a --result path missing or not schema 1 -> rc 2 with a message, status.json not written. No new status.json key. (4) scripts/verify.py gains --result <path> (writes a schema-1 result.json for the cases it ran, through the adapter's result writer, ids = the case modules' unittest ids) and --case <file> (repeatable; selects those case files directly, tags not consulted); --tag/--list/--unit/--all/--no-cache and rc 0/1/2/3 unchanged; code root is AC_CODE_ROOT (row 1). (5) A's board/config.json gains tests: {adapter: 'unittest', unittest: {roots: ['tests'], base: [today's four BASE ids], map: [every row of today's gate.sh map() as {match, ids}, same order, 'add' rows -> ids, ': ;;' / no-test rows -> ids []]}}; gate.sh map() itself stays until row 3b. scripts/project_config.py (row 2) types the tests object.
acceptance: A1 V12 select (tests/test_adapter_unittest.py, A's own config as AC_ROOT, cwd A): table-driven - the test carries, as literal data copied from scripts/gate.sh map() at base 601b36f, one representative path per map row and the ids that row adds; feeding each path alone to 'select --mode branch' prints exactly those ids (set equality, no 'unmapped'); a row with ids [] prints nothing and no 'unmapped'; 'docs/zzz.unknownext' -> exactly 'unmapped docs/zzz.unknownext'; 'tests/test_event.py' -> 'test_event'; 'tests/test_gone_zzz.py' (absent) -> nothing; first-match-wins: a synthetic two-row map in a tmp AC_ROOT ('scripts/*' then 'scripts/x.py') fed 'scripts/x.py' yields the first row's ids only; empty stdin -> rc 3, stderr non-empty; '--mode base' prints exactly test_ticket test_event test_memory test_no_project_names.

A2 run/full write schema 1 (tests/test_adapter_unittest.py, tmp AC_CODE_ROOT with tests/test_fx.py written by the test: one pass, one assertEqual fail, one setUp raise (error), one skip with reason 'fx reason', one skip with empty reason): 'run' of the five ids -> rc 1; result.json: schema 1, command 'run', ids set == the five, statuses pass/fail/error/skip/error, fail row exception 'AssertionError', file 'tests/test_fx.py', line == the assert line number the test computed from the fixture source, message starts 'AssertionError', traceback non-null; skip row message == 'fx reason'; empty-reason row status 'error' with message containing 'without reason'; environment_suspect == []; log == 'run.log' and $AC_TEST_OUT/run.log contains 'Ran 5 tests'. 'full' on the same tree finds the same ids. 'run' with zero ids -> rc 2, no result.json; unset AC_TEST_OUT -> rc 2.

A3 environment suspect (tests/test_adapter_unittest.py + tests/test_status.py): fixture case that prints 'ENVIRONMENT-SUSPECT: firefox fake' then skips (same shape as tests/test_status.py's existing run-tests fixture) -> 'run' rc 86, result environment_suspect has one row, source 'declared', engine 'firefox', all seven D-019 keys present; the statistical path: the existing tests/test_status.py run-tests cases (statistical row, redirect_stdout mutation, one-list suspect file) stay green unchanged through the shim (oracle: tests/test_status.py ~829-1040); rc 86 never comes with environment_suspect [] (asserted on both fixtures).

A4 status.py done --result (tests/test_status.py): from A2's result.json, 'done --ticket 7 --run-id r --rc 1 --result <path>' -> status.json failures[] has exactly the fail and the two error rows with case == id, file/line copied from the rows (null -> '' / 0 as today's parser does for unknown), excerpt == message; from A3's rc-86 result with --state env_suspect -> environment_suspect normalised to seven keys and equal to the file's row; '--result' naming a missing file or a file with schema 2 -> rc 2, stderr names the path, status.json absent. status.json key set identical to a --log run (no new key).

A5 verify.py and A's config (tests/test_verify_runner.py + static): in the harness sandbox with AC_CODE_ROOT=<sandbox>, 'verify.py --case verify/example/test_example.py --result <out>/result.json --no-cache' rc 0 and result.json schema 1 with >= 1 id whose module is verify.example.test_example; '--tag example --result ...' writes the same shape; '--case <missing file>' rc 3 with the path named; existing tests/test_verify_runner.py cases green. Static: A's board/config.json tests.unittest.base == the four BASE ids; tests.unittest.map has one row per case arm of gate.sh map() at base except the tests/test_*.py arm (that rule is the adapter's built-in) - the worker counts the arms at base (opener's rough count ~33, design says 32; not measured exactly) and the test asserts that literal count and that every 'match' string is a verbatim arm pattern from gate.sh (multi-pattern arms 'a|b' become two rows with the same ids); 'python3 scripts/project_config.py check .' rc 0.
test_plan: Worker, foreground, batches: (1) timeout 590 python3 -m unittest tests.test_adapter_unittest tests.test_status; (2) tests.test_verify_runner tests.test_verify_case; (3) tests.test_gate tests.test_land (gate still calls the run-tests shim; both must stay green); report Ran/OK verbatim. Worker writes A1-A3 in tests/test_adapter_unittest.py (new), A4 in tests/test_status.py (new class appended), A5 in tests/test_verify_runner.py + a static class; adds a gate.sh map row scripts/adapter-unittest.py -> test_adapter_unittest test_status test_gate. Verifier (needs_verifier true, interface_fixed true: commands, env, exit codes and the result.json field table are pinned in the design and above) writes tests/test_adapter_cases.py (new) in parallel from the section 4 table: at least a fixture with two roots (tests + demo/tests, T's shape) where 'full' discovers both and 'run demo_mod.T.test_x' works, a fail inside a helper called from the test (file/line must still be the test-file frame), and a result where ids returned != ids passed is impossible (pass an id that does not exist -> error row for that id, never a missing row). Mutations (not measured by opener): m1 file/line from the outermost frame -> A2 red; m2 select ignores first-match-wins -> A1 red; m3 run rc 0 with zero ids -> A2 red; m4 done --result excerpt from traceback -> A4 red; m5 empty-reason skip reported as skip -> A2 red. Container runs as uid 0: no chmod-based unreadable-file cases (root reads them); use a missing file or invalid JSON instead. hard_block.patterns forbids the four process-signal spellings in added tests/** lines: never stop a child that way in a test; timeouts belong to subprocess.run(timeout=) inside scripts/.
